## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `structure-conditioned-signal-weighting`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-08-07T11:23:09.664Z.

Catalog entry (29) — structure-conditioned signal weighting: the graph term earns its weight from the measured resolution of the graph, not from a fitted constant.

Extends the catalog. Entries 1 through 28 stand unchanged.

## The problem this entry names

Every graph-derived relevance signal in this catalog — typed distance to the caller's outcome, dominator overlap, community co-membership, blast-radius rank — assumes the typed graph has resolution: that different candidates sit at different structural distances from what the caller is doing. The assumption was never checked.

Measured 2026-08-07 over all 2,357 items, following only typed edges and excluding the two untyped kinds: 1,024 of 2,007 terminal items reach the roadmap apex and no outcome milestone at all, and the 350 active items occupy exactly four distinct hop distances, with 282 of them at one or two. For most candidate sets the engine could assemble today, typed distance is a constant. A scorer multiplying a fitted weight against a constant produces a confident number that carries no information, and — worse — the constant is not zero, so the graph term systematically displaces terms that do carry information.

This is the same class as the calibration hazard already recorded on the behavioural-constants item: every threshold in this engine was fitted against one corpus. Entry (29) is narrower and structural. It is not that the weight is wrong for other corpora. It is that the weight is wrong for *this* corpus at *this* query, and the engine has no way to notice.

## Mechanism one — informativeness gating

For each assembly, after candidate generation and before scoring, compute the distribution of the structural feature over the candidate set and take its normalized Shannon entropy. Concretely, for typed distance to the caller's outcome anchor, bucket the candidates by hop count, form the empirical distribution over occupied buckets, and divide by the log of the bucket count. The result is a number in zero to one that answers a single question: does this feature separate these candidates?

The graph term's weight for that assembly is its declared prior multiplied by that number. Entropy near zero means every candidate is structurally identical, the term contributes nothing, and the budget it would have consumed is reallocated proportionally across the terms whose own informativeness is non-zero — recency, usage affinity, lifecycle salience. Entropy near one means the structure genuinely separates the candidates and the term carries its full declared prior.

Three properties make this the right shape rather than a heuristic.

It is self-correcting across the corpus lifetime. When the terminal backfill waves land and hop distances spread from four buckets to ten, the same statistic raises the graph term's weight automatically. No retune, no new constant, and no migration — the tuning surface is the corpus, which is what changed.

It spans the declared scale spectrum without a mode switch. On a three-item scratch workspace every candidate is at distance zero or one, entropy collapses, and the engine degrades to recency ordering, which is the correct behaviour at that size and is currently achieved only by a separate small-workspace code path. At a million items with a deep graph, entropy is high and structure dominates. One statistic replaces the branch.

It is honest about its own inputs, which is the property the attestation work requires. The per-term informativeness values are exactly the receipt an attested assembly needs to be reproducible and checkable: they say not only what was returned but which signals were load-bearing and which were inert.

The refusal boundary matters and is stated here so it cannot be over-applied. Informativeness gating decides *weight*, never *membership*. A candidate is never excluded because a feature failed to separate it. Gating a term to zero must be visible in the receipt rather than silent, because a zeroed graph term is a diagnosis of the graph, and the diagnosis is worth more than the score.

## Mechanism two — bounded exact distance at corpus scale

Informativeness gating requires typed distance for every candidate on every assembly, which a per-query breadth-first search cannot supply inside the latency and token budgets at a million items. Use pruned landmark labeling over the typed subgraph.

Choose landmarks as the outcome milestones plus the highest-betweenness hubs, on the order of a few dozen. Precompute, for each node, the distance to each landmark that is not already covered by a closer landmark's label — the standard two-hop cover pruning. Exact distance between any node and any landmark is then a bounded label lookup rather than a traversal, and the label set is small precisely because this graph is a shallow star, which is the one respect in which the structural defect helps.

Maintenance is incremental and append-only, which matches the storage model. An added edge can only shorten distances, so it triggers a bounded relaxation from the edge's endpoints rather than a rebuild. Edge removal is the expensive direction and is rare here; it schedules a background rebuild rather than blocking a read, and until the rebuild lands the labels are conservatively stale in the safe direction, meaning distances may be overstated and the informativeness statistic understated, which biases toward under-weighting structure rather than over-trusting it.

The label set is content-addressed by the hash of the typed edge set. That makes it exactly the artifact the fleet-amortized assembly work needs: a thousand agents asking a thousand different questions against one unchanged graph share one label computation, and a single edge write invalidates precisely the labels it touches rather than the whole index.

## Sequencing and dependencies

This entry cannot be validated before the graph has resolution to measure. Its natural order is: the ladder-topology disposition and the terminal backfill waves establish real depth; the relevance evaluation harness records a pre-change baseline against the degenerate graph, which is a valuable baseline precisely because it is degenerate; then gating lands and the harness measures whether assemblies improved. If the harness shows no improvement after depth appears, that is evidence the structural family of signals does not pay for itself in this domain, and the catalog should record that finding rather than defend the family.

## What this entry deliberately does not propose

No learned weights. No embedding-based structural similarity. Both were considered and both fail the reproducibility requirement that attested assemblies impose: an assembly must be recomputable from recorded state alone, and a learned weight is recorded state only if the training corpus and procedure are also recorded, which is a much larger commitment than this entry is making. Entropy over an observed distribution is computed from the candidate set itself and is trivially reproducible.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
